The second publication preserves incoming 4885980a and identical owned worker/reload/harness blobs. RCH code is published at 33e68124 with orchestration blob 89154dd2. The combined CLI selected suite passed on prior blob 08b8729a; only a misplaced pre-existing Clippy allowance was subsequently relocated. Strict CLI lint, final formatting, executable build, and 17 daemon plus 8 jobs lifecycle tests passed on that published RCH source. Final synthetic process integration used rebuilt daemon b7a0785e and CLI c331c6d0, distinct from earlier OpenSSH measurements. The supporting seven-file RABS correction was tested and published unchanged as 3b69bf58; full-workspace check, strict Clippy, formatting and selected runtime tests all passed. No blanket all-workspace runtime-test claim is made.

additional_upstream_at_second_publicatio.scope: Concurrent RABS leaf metadata and RCH disk-budget/Darwin census changes were preserved. They did not alter the owned worker/reload/harness files. Combined CLI testing passed both the new upstream disk-budget regression and the owned custom-target retrieval regression.

discarded_unpublished_commits.status: Discarded without publication: its blob predates restoration of the pre-existing too_many_arguments allowance to execute_remote_compilation_inner.

defects.baseline: A failed durable remove deleted the live bypass record, stranding an existing quarantine outside the recovery scanner.
defects.correction: Persist the proposed map before replacing the live map; failed retirement retains the exact record and its recovery path.

defects.baseline: Configuration retirement replaced Disabled with Draining while three owned slots prevented removal, allowing new background SSH dials.
defects.correction: Track configuration absence independently from operator intent, retain pending disablement, and clear only removal intent on identical reintroduction.
defects.candidate_process_requirement: Removal, identical re-addition and daemon restart must produce zero dials while three original slots remain owned. Explicit enable must await successful health evidence; explicit original-build release is the only slot-completion event.
defects.additional_recovery_guarantee: Same-endpoint inventory-only resume wakes waiting monitors while preserving the existing next-probe deadline. A paused-clock test checks healthy 30-second and offline 900-second due times exactly.

defects.source_finding: The fresh custom-target transfer pipeline omitted the execution pipeline's source-authority identity.
defects.correction: Attach the original identity before staging so size/header probes, rsync and retrieval retries use the same activity and cancellation fence.
